Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for the operation of roll your own cigarette machines at retail establishments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to persons who operate a roll your own cigarettemachine at retail establishments; adding a new section to chapter70.158 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 70.155 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.158 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For the purposes of this chapter and chapters 70.157 and 82.24 RCW,every owner or retailer who maintains a machine at a retailestablishment that enables a person to process a product made orderived from tobacco into a roll or tube shall be deemed to be amanufacturer of cigarettes. The resulting product shall be deemed tobe a cigarette.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.155 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A retailer may allow a person to process a product made or derivedfrom tobacco into a roll or tube by use of a machine. A retailer isprohibited from permitting the use of the machine by a person: p. 1 SHB 2565 (1) With tobacco, rolls, or tubes that are not purchased from thatretail establishment; or (2) At a time that is not contemporaneous to the time of thepurchase of the tobacco, rolls, or tubes.
